prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic style, vertical screen, first-person visitor perspective. Inside a dimly lit KTV private room, purple and blue neon laser lights flicker in the background. An adult Asian woman sits on a black leather sofa, long black hair draped over her shoulders, wearing a black off-shoulder sequin sweater and an exquisite necklace. Initially she looks to the side, then turns her head toward the camera with a warm playful smile and says, "Hello, you arrived late." The camera smoothly pans down to show her silver pointed high-heeled shoe covered in diamond-like details. She removes the shoe naturally and lazily, with one foot already barefoot on the reflective floor. Keep realistic light and shadow texture and high-definition image quality.
